t: What the whole thing stands on
a: بُنِيَ الإِسْلاَمُ عَلَى خَمْسٍ شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَإِقَامِ الصَّلاَةِ، وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ، وَالْحَجِّ، وَصَوْمِ رَمَضَانَ
p: Buniya-l-islāmu ʿalā khams: shahādati an lā ilāha illā-Llāhu wa anna Muḥammadan rasūlu-Llāh, wa iqāmi-ṣ-ṣalāh, wa ītāʾi-z-zakāh, wa-l-ḥajj, wa ṣawmi Ramaḍān
m: Islam is built on five: testifying that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, establishing the prayer, giving the zakat, the pilgrimage, and fasting Ramadan.
